hard_rules: Do not uniformly rescale a standard-body design into a non-standard body.
Existing validated components are preferred when they satisfy the design.
Fine surface detail may move from geometry to print/omission when physical scale requires it.
Mechanical grip scale and visual accessory scale are separate.
BodyGenerationConditioning must preserve the authority class of every joint/connector source.
Reference-only CAD or validation-pending joints may condition keep-outs and alignment but may not become production mating geometry.
Reference height and target design height are separate; fitting normalized proportions never silently changes requested product scale.
Commodity hardware remains at fixed physical dimensions even when normalized copies are supplied to image/mesh generators.

conditioning_layers.skeleton: Fitted/selected normalized landmarks and links used for architecture/proportion alignment.
conditioning_layers.visual_envelope: Independent width/depth/height targets for visual shell mass; never substitutes for joint spacing.
conditioning_layers.mechanical_constraints: Deterministic or reference-only interface/keep-out records with explicit authority state.
conditioning_layers.component_plan: Editable shell regions, locked regions and architecture component/split expectations.
